structural_change: S81-HWIN-1021 successor of c21p (gate FAIL: trial GRT overflow 0 / M3 ~11%, but 5_1_grt aborted GATE_GRT_RC=2 with [ERROR EST-0104] inconsistent parasitics state in ORFS post-GRT repair_timing -sequence 'vt_swap reroute'). Cause: the HWIN detailed_placement wrapper binds PG on repair births (CANDIDATE_BIRTH_PG_READY newly_bound=466) inside global_route -start/-end_incremental; the incremental reroute move then sees inconsistent parasitics. Only kits with this in-DPL PG bind hit it (15 recent ep9 gates: all others pass this step). Fix: the kit pre_grt.tcl sets ::env(OPT_POST_GRT_WNS) 0 (same effect as the s81pq native kits' orfs_var; kept out of orfs_vars so the source contract and ROOT planning budget stay byte-equal) skips the post-GRT reroute WNS pass only; every other repair, PG bind, fence/band hook, RTL, macros, pins, outline unchanged; pd 0.48.
